content: शूना [श्वि-अधिकरणे -क्त संप्र˚ दीर्घ <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 The soft palate, uvula. .²2 A slaughter house in general. .²3 Anything (such as a piece of household furniture), whereby life is likely to be destroyed; (these are five:-- a fireplace, a grind-stone, a broom, a mortar, and a waterpot; पञ्च शूना गृहस्थस्य चुल्ली पेषण्युपस्करः . कण्डनी चोदकुम्भश्च वध्यते यास्तु वाहयन् <ls>Ms. 3. 68.</ls>). See सूना.
